_comment: The official AML/KYC regulation corpus indexed into Vertex AI Search.
The PDFs themselves are gitignored (docai/regulations_corpus/); this file
is the metadata that travels with them: it supplies the document title and
the official issuing-authority URL that every returned passage must carry,
and it is the closed set of documents a citation may name. A citation whose
document is not in this file did not come from this corpus.
Fetch instructions and checksums-by-size are in the repo README under

documents.title: RBI Master Direction - Know Your Customer (KYC) Direction, 2016
documents.version: RBI/DBR/2015-16/18, issued 25 Feb 2016, updated as on 14 Aug 2025

documents.title: Prevention of Money-laundering (Maintenance of Records) Rules, 2005
documents.version: as amended to the Third Amendment Rules, 2023
